root.label: National poll on opposition to data centers

events.label: National poll on opposition to data centers

slots.name: data center opposition
slots.sentence: So, opposition to data centers has gone up to 61 percent.

slots.name: opposition increase
slots.sentence: This is more than 10 points, more than a 10-point jump in just a few months.

slots.name: rapid construction opposition
slots.sentence: This year, 64% of respondents to a Reuters/Ipsos survey said they do not think it is a “good thing to build data centers at a rapid rate.”

slots.name: electricity rate worry
slots.sentence: Seventy-seven percent say they worry data centers will increase their electricity rates, and in classic NIMBY—or “not in my backyard”—fashion, only 14% say they would be willing to live close to a data center.

slots.name: nearby living willingness
slots.sentence: only 14% say they would be willing to live close to a data center.

slots.name: public support
slots.sentence: About 6 in 10 Americans support limiting the number of new data centers that can be built, including most Democrats and Republicans.
